description: Seed-needs extraction goldens (#2731). Each case gives a help request's own title + description; the model must recover the claimable things the text plainly names as seed_needs, one per named thing, without inventing extras. Precision guards over-extraction (a wrongly-added need makes the request read as more demanding than it is); recall guards dropped items. Run: go test -tags=benchmark ./server/ai/eval -run TestRequestSuggestionsPrompt -provider gemini -gemini-project <proj>.
